import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12; W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,I)
    for cls, dim in [(ColumnParallelLinear,0),(RowParallelLinear,1)]:
        m=cls(I,O,True,W); ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        xi=x.clone().requires_grad_(); xr=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        y=m(xi); yr=ref(xr); assert torch.allclose(y,yr,atol=1e-5)
        (y*torch.arange(y.numel()).view_as(y)).sum().backward()
        (yr*torch.arange(yr.numel()).view_as(yr)).sum().backward()
        c=ref.weight.grad.chunk(ws,dim=dim)[rank]; assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,c,atol=1e-4)
        bg=ref.bias.grad.chunk(ws)[rank] if dim==0 else ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,bg,atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(xi.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-4)
    if rank==0: print('ok', ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate([1,2,4]): mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
